command: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$taskNet = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '"'..\\inputs\\旧网络未确认-完整输入输出.json' | ConvertFrom-Json; "'$taskNet.failure | Select-Object message,titleEditable,bodyEditable,saveDisabled | ConvertTo-Json; $taskNet.recovery | Select-Object remoteHeading | ConvertTo-Json; foreach ($taskEvent in $taskNet.events) { [pscustomobject]@{method=$taskEvent.method;path=$taskEvent.path;status=$taskEvent.status;failure=$taskEvent.failure;input=($taskEvent.input | Select-Object workId,chapterNumber,expectedWorkRevision,expectedChapterRevision,expectedPreviousRevisions,title);outputKeys=($taskEvent.output.PSObject.Properties.Name -join '"',');outputWorkId="'$taskEvent.output.work.id;outputChapterRevisions=@($taskEvent.output.chapters | Select-Object number,revision)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 }; $taskBase=$taskNet.initial.chapters | Where-Object number -eq 2; $taskSubmitted=($taskNet.events | Where-Object method -eq POST).input; [pscustomobject]@{initialRevision=$taskBase.revision;submittedEqualsInitial=$taskSubmitted.body -ceq $taskBase.body;submittedTitleEqualsInitial=$taskSubmitted.title -ceq $taskBase.title;submittedSuffix=$taskSubmitted.body.Substring($taskBase.body.Length);failureStoredRevision=$taskNet.failure.currentStored.revision;recoveryStoredRevision=$taskNet.recovery.currentStored.revision;recoveryStoredMatchesFullInitial=($taskNet.recovery.currentStored | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress) -ceq (($taskBase | Select-Object * -ExcludeProperty basisCurrent) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress);failureLocalMatchesSubmitted=$taskNet.failure.body -ceq $taskSubmitted.body;recoveryLocalMatchesSubmitted=$taskNet.recovery.localBody -ceq $taskSubmitted.body;remoteMatchesInitial=$taskNet.recovery.remoteBody -ceq $taskBase.body} | ConvertTo-Json'
